name: splats
summary: Gaussian splat viewer on the r186 native GaussianSplat (WebGPURenderer, WebGL 2 fallback): SPLATLoader, a generated 24,000-splat scene, load and error states, backend readout, auto-rotate off for reduced motion
use_for: showing a small or medium splat capture on a page
the base for mixing splats with TSL materials or node post-processing
next: replace scene.splat with your capture and set SPLAT_URL (.ply, .spz and .ksplat have their own loaders)
large or streamed scenes: use Spark instead (tw kb show gaussian-splats)
node make-splat.mjs rebuilds the sample file

verified.platform: Windows 11, Chrome 153 headless, NVIDIA RTX 5060 Ti
verified.checks: tw check --webgpu OK on the real WebGPU backend (page reports 24,000 splats), tw check --gl swiftshader OK on the WebGL 2 fallback, tw check --reduced-motion OK, tw lint clean, tw shot looked at on both backends: striped sphere, petal ring and ground disc, sorted correctly
